normalization_notes: Field names, official type labels, presence labels, explicit enum values and numeric bounds are normalized from the official reference retrieved at retrieved_at; source order is preserved.
Full source prose is not duplicated in this contract. Each field retains its official section anchor and table-row locator for direct review.
Conditional prose that is not mapped unambiguously to the G01 condition vocabulary remains operator=null and NEEDS_REVIEW.
Unstated empty-value, range and format semantics remain UNKNOWN or NOT_SPECIFIED; recommendations are not converted to hard constraints.
Foreign-reference targets are metadata only. G03 does not enforce entity existence; ownership is G04.
Only G01 FULL_V1_TECHNICAL files are normalized. Deferred files remain listed without field rows.
No files are declared FIELD_METADATA_COMPLETE_FOR_G03 while conditional semantics, unresolved type definitions or extension policy remain open.
